title: Market-data state frame
description: The data of the panel socket's `md-state/<instrumentId>` topic (decision 0007 §2.16): how fresh the order book and the trades on screen are, as the runtime's liveness classifier (decision 0006 §2.2-2.3) sees them. One frame per channel on subscribe and on every change. The panel keeps no clock of its own on venue data: STALE greys the view with 'delayed since', ABSENT greys retained data with 'no data', except pending first frames; trades never grey on their own silence (QUIET). Mirrors src/panel/model/frames.ts (MdStateFrame) and src/runtime/marketdata/marketdata.ts.

instrument.description: The instrument id, as in the topic.

channel.description: book: the worst current book lease, with pending first frames below LIVE/QUIET; trades: the tape.

state.description: LIVE: fresh; QUIET: the timer channels are fresh and nobody traded lately; STALE: a check failed, the last value is kept with its age; ABSENT: no usable value.

pending.description: Optional, true only for ABSENT while a newly opened lease awaits its first frame within 30 seconds. Keep retained data without a no-data notice. Omitted/false retains the existing ABSENT behavior; noFirstFrame and staleTooLong are never pending. Additive; nothing is stored or journaled.

since.description: Wall milliseconds. STALE: the last fresh frame ("delayed since"). LIVE or QUIET: when the run began. ABSENT: when the wait began.
